head: ChatGPT lets you lock private chats behind a PIN
dek: OpenAI is rolling out Locked Chats: a locked conversation moves out of your chat history, pinned chats and search into a separate section that opens only with a four-digit PIN, or Face ID, Touch ID or your phone's unlock.
details: It's on Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu plans, on the web, the iPhone and Android apps and the Mac and Windows apps. Temporary, archived and group chats can't be locked. It isn't end-to-end encryption, and it doesn't change how long OpenAI keeps your data. If you reset a forgotten PIN, all locked chats, their files and memories are deleted for good.
where: All ChatGPT plans except ChatGPT for Healthcare, rolling out gradually
means: If other people use your phone or computer, you can keep some ChatGPT conversations out of sight. It hides chats; it doesn't make them more secret from OpenAI.
todo: Open a chat's menu and choose Lock chat; if it isn't there yet, it hasn't reached your account. Pick a PIN you won't forget. Locking doesn't cancel links you already shared, so delete those separately.
